# Check original code behavior step by step
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['git', 'stash', 'pop'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Stash pop:", result.stdout[:200])

# Now test with original code
result2 = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import get_name, stashedHTML2text, unescape

md_text = """[TOC]

# `<test>`
"""
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])

# Parse document manually
lines = md_text.strip().split("\n")
tree = md.parser.parseDocument(lines)

for el in tree.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        name = get_name(el)
        print(f"get_name: {repr(name)}")
        
        sht = stashedHTML2text(name, md)
        print(f"stashedHTML2text: {repr(sht)}")
        
        u = unescape(sht)
        print(f"unescape: {repr(u)}")
        
        from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify
        sl = slugify(u, '-')
        print(f"slugify: {repr(sl)}")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result2.stdout)
if result2.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result2.stderr[-300:])
